purpose: Teach: キルト/デッサン/ライフワーク/レインボー/ハヤカワ/ローソン/ベースボール/グリーンピース

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがキルトを縫ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm quilting at the moment.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Stitching slowly as she speaks. Gentle eye contact. A small smile in her voice—inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとデッサンの練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced sketching with Dad today.
lines.style: Small voice, bright underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift at the end—sharing something he did, not asking for praise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宇宙研究をライフワークにされてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's made space research his life's work, hasn't he.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Noticing something. Not a question, more an observation offered gently. Slightly distant, like she's thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、雨上がりにレインボー見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a rainbow after the rain today.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet wonder. Guileless delight. The small intake of breath before sharing something he noticed. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハヤカワ文庫を貸して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's offered to lend you some Hayakawa books.
lines.style: Tender observation, slightly careful. Like she's witnessing something between father and son and wants him to feel it too. Warm pause before 'Hayakawa'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとローソンに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the convenience store with Dad.
lines.style: Small, satisfied voice. Not much to it, but matter-of-fact. The comfort of ordinary time. Quiet contentment underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベースボールのグローブを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought you a baseball glove.
lines.style: Gentle warmth. The kind of quiet happiness that comes from witnessing tenderness between people. Slight breath of emotion held steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとグリーンピースのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a Greenpeace documentary with Dad.
lines.style: Clear, unburdened voice. A small proud note. He's sharing something that mattered to them both. Ending with quiet contentment.
